page_title: 让每一次申论作答，都得到具体反馈

summary.name: 申阅官 (WriteWise)
summary.one_liner: 申阅官 is a paid Chinese-language service for civil service and public institution exam candidates that automatically grades 申论 (essay) answers and shows scoring, key-point hits, and reference answers.
use_cases: Getting automated feedback on 申论 practice answers
Checking which key points an answer covered
Comparing your answer with reference answers after practice
Preparing for civil service or public institution exams
Reviewing writing style and expression issues
summary.what_it_does: The page describes an essay grader for 申论 answers that analyzes a response against the question requirements and shows an overall score, content completeness, key-point accuracy, and language standards. It marks hit, partially hit, and missed points with scoring rationale. Users can view reference answers in several versions and standard expressions for post-practice review. A free trial shows a full report without registration or login, and paid tiers unlock unlimited grading, reference answers, and key-point annotations.
notable: Free trial report without login or registration
Marks hit, partial, and missed key points with scoring basis
Multiple versions of reference answers and standard expression examples
caveats: Full learning services require an account; paid plans range from ¥6 for answer lookup to ¥120 per year
Refunds are generally not offered for used membership time or content services
Targets Chinese civil service and public institution exam candidates
